Open-ended: fee keeps rising $20 per additional 1,000 lb above 80,000 lb (not represented).

CY2026 electric/alternative fuel registration fee = road usage charge cap $180/yr (Utah Code 41-1a-1206(1)(g)(i); 72-1-213.1(12)(a)(ii)); amount listed in OLRGC briefing Fig. 1. Not CPI-adjusted in 2026. From 10/1/2026 statute expressly includes commercial EVs >=6,001 lb GCWR; from 1/1/2027 commercial EV cap rises to $500/yr (72-1-213.1(12)(c)). Fee applies 'in addition to the fee described in Subsection (1)(b)' (vehicles <=14,000 lb), so it stops at 14,000 lb; no alternative-fuel registration fee for (1)(e) vehicles >14,000 lb. Owners of EVs/alt-fuel vehicles may instead enroll in UDOT's road usage charge program (per-mile, capped at the same amount).

Same $180 road usage charge cap applies to a motor vehicle 'fueled exclusively by a source other than motor fuel, diesel fuel, natural gas, or propane' (41-1a-1206(1)(g)(i)(C); 72-1-213.1(1)(b) alternative fuel vehicle). Hydrogen is not in the excluded list, so a hydrogen FCEV is read as covered (statute does not name hydrogen).
